title: Polynomial-time long-code transform
statement: Let a family of regular unique games, a finite family of allowed sign predicates, a tester using only predicates from that family, and a finite long-code transform be given, together with a binary codec for the transform’s finite CSP outputs. A polynomial-time map from binary strings to binary strings is required to send the canonical encoding of each semantic instance to exactly the codec’s encoding of that instance’s output.
hypotheses_covered: A family of regular unique games with parameter q
A finite allowed predicate family and a tester whose checks use only those predicates
A long-code finite transform for the family and tester
A binary codec for the transform’s outputs
For every semantic instance, the map sends its canonical encoding to the codec’s encoded output
